runtimeIdentity.method: Corroborative-only comparison of Azure ImagePulled references and byte counts with current OCI manifest/config/layer byte sums and ACR tag timestamps
runtimeIdentity.limitation: The three tag objects remain write-enabled, and equal byte length is not content identity. Independent review rejected the pull-size/timestamp join as digest proof. The api-gateway, market-data-service and insight-service runtime digests therefore remain UNVERIFIED independently of the Kafka failure; only portfolio-service is configured by immutable digest.

failedOrUnverifiedPredicates: Every current serving revision must be bound to an immutable runtime digest.
Every market-prices partition must have committed offset equal to log end for both portfolio-group and insight-group.
stopDecision.observed: Runtime identity remains unverified for the three mutable-tag revisions, and insight-group does not exist in broker group metadata.
stopDecision.reason: The approved fail-closed protocol makes either an unresolved immutable identity or an absent/inconclusive group a hard stop. Equal pull byte counts cannot prove content identity. Creating or waking a consumer to manufacture group state would join the group and could commit offsets, which this evidence protocol expressly forbids.
